name: Configurable Gmail PDF Intake and Notification Router

parameters.content:
## Configurable Gmail PDF Intake and Notification Router

### Purpose

This workflow turns unread Gmail messages into a controlled PDF intake process. It searches with the configured keyword, keeps only valid PDF attachments, uploads each PDF to Google Drive, and sends one concise delivery summary through Slack or Telegram.

### Configure before activation

1. Edit Set - Global Config: search_keyword, target_drive_folder_id, notification_channel, slack_channel_id, and telegram_chat_id.
2. Select and test Gmail and Google Drive credentials.
3. Select one notification credential and disable the unused adapter if it has no credential.
4. Use n8n's manual Execute Workflow button for a controlled check, then inspect the normalized record, upload count, and destination message before relying on the daily schedule.

### Runtime contract

Messages without valid PDFs are skipped without a Drive side effect. Multiple PDFs are uploaded independently and reported as one summary. Sanitized errors identify the failed node without exposing credentials.

### Safe customization

Change values in Set - Global Config or the notification formatter only. Keep normalized field names stable so the upload and routing branches remain compatible.

## 01 · Configuration and Gmail Intake

Daily Gmail PDF Intake Schedule starts the scheduled daily run. Set - Global Config is the operator control panel for the Gmail keyword, Drive folder, notification channel, and destination IDs. Gmail - Search Unread PDFs searches unread messages with attachments and the configured keyword. Edit Fields - Normalize Email maps provider-specific data to the stable contract: subject, sender, body, attachments, pdf_count, channel, and destination IDs. Use a narrow keyword and never place credentials in these fields.

Nodes: Daily Gmail PDF Intake Schedule · Gmail - Search Unread PDFs · Set - Global Config · Code - Format Error Notification · Error Trigger · Edit Fields - Normalize Email

## 02 · PDF Validation and Drive Storage

IF - Has PDF Attachments keeps only valid PDF attachments. Code - Split PDF Attachments creates one item per PDF, and Google Drive - Upload PDF writes each item to target_drive_folder_id. No-PDF messages take the clean skip path with uploaded_count = 0. Build Notification Summary aggregates successful upload IDs and counts so partial failures remain visible.

Nodes: IF - Has PDF Attachments · Google Drive - Upload PDF · Code - Split PDF Attachments · Code - Build Notification Summary · Code - No PDF Summary · Code - Format Notification

## 03 · Notification Routing and Delivery

Switch: Notification Channel evaluates notification_channel exactly. The selected adapter receives sender, subject, uploaded PDF count, and Drive folder ID. Configure one destination and press D on the unused adapter when its credential is not available. Verify the destination message; a successful execution alone is not proof of delivery.

Nodes: Switch: Notification Channel · Slack - Send Notification · Telegram - Send Notification

parameters.content:
## 04 · Error Reporting

### Failure behavior

Continue On Fail preserves sanitized errors from recoverable Gmail, Drive, and notification failures. Error Trigger formats authentication, quota, missing-folder, and invalid-destination failures with the failed node and safe message.

### Recovery procedure

1. Inspect the first failing integration node.
2. Test the selected credential and destination access.
3. Repair only the affected mapping or configuration.
4. Rerun with a controlled unread message and confirm upload and notification evidence.

Do not treat a successful execution with uploaded_count = 0 as proof that a file was stored.

Nodes: Error Trigger · Code - Format Error Notification
